interpretation: Before is compared against the supplemented version. Scores describe agreement between versions; no independent accuracy improvement is estimable.
input_channels: separate binary masks; no cross-class overlap overwritten or discarded
nsd_tolerance_note: Fixed exploratory tolerance chosen for this comparison; not a verified paper threshold.

notes: binary: prediction and reference are identical; check that the evaluation is not against itself.

protocol.implementation: independent fixed protocol, not VesMamba authors code
protocol.NSD: surfel-area weighted surface Dice, inclusive distance <= tolerance
protocol.HD95: max of directional area-weighted 95th percentiles, surface-distance 0.1, mm
protocol.clDice: 3D Lee skeleton, voxel-count precision/sensitivity, no pruning
protocol.postprocessing: none; union bbox crop removes only shared background, then zero padding
protocol.empty_policy: both empty=null; one empty overlap metrics=0, HD95=null with failure status

notes: DSC/Precision/Recall use standard unsmoothed one-versus-rest voxel counts.
FPR is supplementary: the AirRC paper calculated it but omitted it from result tables.
No uncertainty/ignore mask is supported. Do not turn uncertain or unannotated voxels into background.
Array inputs do not retain image affine. Caller must verify identical orientation, origin and grid.
AirRC does not fully specify branch extraction/matching in the inspected text. These branch metrics are an independent GT-centreline coverage protocol, not author-exact BDR/DLR.

protocol.name: AirRC_independent_evaluation_v1

author_code_check.finding: training validation uses MONAI DiceMetric; BDR/DLR final evaluation implementation not found in these files

protocol.zero_denominator: None, with reason in status; never add epsilon
protocol.FPR_definition: FP/(FP+TN), negatives are all voxels not in this GT class
protocol.case_aggregation: per-case outputs; aggregation is caller responsibility

branch_protocol.branch_definition: fixed supplied reference branch IDs; no automatic branch extraction
branch_protocol.length: sum of unique 26-neighbour intra-ID centerline edge lengths in mm
branch_protocol.edge_coverage: edge is covered only if BOTH endpoints lie in predicted airway lumen
branch_protocol.BDR: number of detected supplied GT branches / number of supplied GT branches
branch_protocol.DLR: FULL lengths of detected supplied GT branches / lengths of all supplied GT branches
branch_protocol.prediction_branch_matching: none; uses prediction lumen mask, not predicted branch IDs
branch_protocol.reference_completeness: caller must review completeness and freeze branch IDs before comparisons
branch_protocol.junction_convention: cross-ID edges and unlabelled junction voxels excluded from length denominator

not_computable.airway_BDR_DLR: No frozen reviewed reference branch-ID centerline map.
not_computable.airway_wall: No airway-wall mask; lung is not wall.
not_computable.MCS: Supplemented arterial/venous masks are nonexclusive; standard single-label MCS is not computed.
